mostWorthwhile.text: Aerobic ATP renewal was the most worthwhile construction: its illustration plan connects fuel oxidation and oxygen to a hydrogen-ion gradient and ATP synthase, rather than treating them as interchangeable inputs.

leastWorthwhile.text: Installing the pump was a predictable intermediate step; its main value was setting up the more informative powered-transport result.

surprise.text: The aerobic result explicitly showed hydrogen ions being pumped across the inner mitochondrial membrane and returning through ATP synthase, making the energy-transfer connection more concrete.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although pairing an ATP-renewal construction directly with amino acids compresses several steps; the result explains ATP's supporting role but assumes an existing RNA message.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue: the planned comparisons between passive channels and powered pumps, and the connection from fuel to ATP use, made the constructions informative. The compatible-option menu made the route straightforward rather than a compatibility-discovery challenge.
